name: add_tests_kotlin_roman_numeral
description: Write kotlin tests for an int-to-Roman-numeral formatter; mutation-checked (900/CM dropped from the subtractive table, >= loosened to >, range off-by-one)
prompts: RomanNumeral.format(n) in RomanNumeral.kt (already correct - do not modify it) formats an int from 1 to 3999 as a Roman numeral, using the standard subtractive notation (4 is IV, 9 is IX, 1994 is MCMXCIV), and throws IllegalArgumentException for n outside that range. Write a JUnit 5 test class at exactly RomanNumeralTest.kt (functions annotated @Test, org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions, exact expected strings) with at least 5 test functions covering: simple single-symbol values, at least two subtractive pairs including 900 (CM), a compound value like 1994, the boundary value 3999, and both ends of the invalid range (0 and 4000) throwing IllegalArgumentException.

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
"""Mutation harness: model tests must PASS the real implementation and FAIL
each mutant. Uses a Python-level subprocess timeout (not a shell `timeout`
wrapper) so a hung mutant can never corrupt this host-mounted workspace."""
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path("src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/RomanNumeral.kt")
MUTANTS = [
    # 900 (CM) dropped from the subtractive table - 900 built the "wrong"
    # way as DCD-ish nonsense once C's below 900 keep firing
    ['1000 to "M", 900 to "CM", 500 to "D", 400 to "CD",',
     '1000 to "M", 500 to "D", 400 to "CD",'],
    # >= loosened to > : a value exactly equal to remaining is skipped once
    ['            while (remaining >= value) {',
     '            while (remaining > value) {'],
    # range upper bound off by one
    ['        require(n in 1..3999) { "n out of range: $n" }',
     '        require(n in 1..4000) { "n out of range: $n" }'],
]


def run_tests() -> int:
    for p in Path(".").rglob("__pycache__"):
        shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
    try:
        return subprocess.run(
            ["mvn", "-o", "-q", "test", "-Dtest=RomanNumeralTest"], timeout=180
        ).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return 124


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to "
        f"change it (anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately "
            f"broken implementation, so they do not verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)")
